_calibration.integer_budget: Validate an integer budget against an explicit minimum. The caller identifies whether it limits cells, interactions or samples; it does not estimate total RAM.
basic_processing.ThinPlateGridder.__init: Build TPS interpolation from coordinates and values with smoothing and global or neighbour support. Check geometry and cost before evaluation; defaults do not choose a geological scale.
channel_filters.ChannelFilterOptions: 1D filter configuration: method, domain, axis, groups, sensor, continuity, window, cutoffs and budgets. Fields/defaults are listed; validate checks compatibility.
channel_filters.ChannelFilterOptions.val: Check method/domain, required temporal/spatial axis, odd window, thresholds, cutoffs, uniformity and per-run limit. Reject incompatible recipes.
channel_filters.ChannelFilterOptions.to_: Serialise option fields to a dictionary. This retains recipe settings, not execution or inferred acquisition metadata.
grid_tools.directional_filter: Apply a directional notch to a 2D grid: nearest filling for calculation, reflected padding and restoration of original support. Return grid and removed-difference diagnostics; follow the module's angle/row convention.
grid_tools.mosaic_files: Read two to 32 distinct north-up, single-band rasters with compatible metric CRS, resolution and units, then prepare the configured mosaic. Requires rasterio; it does not convert physical units.
grid_tools.wavelet_settings: Validate shape, cell, stripe direction in grid axes, wavelet family, levels, strength and padding. Levels are numerical scales, not inferred geological layers.
gridding_methods.MinimumCurvatureGridder: Prepare observations and experimental minimum-curvature controls: support, desampling, tolerances, tension, boundaries and solver. Small cells and iteration limits do not guarantee resolution or convergence.
gridding_methods.SincGridder.__init__: Prepare sinc interpolation with explicit coordinates, values and spacing. Radius, blanking and fallback define support for queries; review the sampling assumption.
gridding_methods.SincGridder.evaluate: Evaluate queries using the configured sinc interpolator, support policy and cancellation. No new sampling or CRS conversion is chosen.
gridding_methods.SincGridder.grid: Evaluate sinc on supplied X/Y axes, which define output lattice and size. Supports cancellation and progress.
inversion.InversionResult: Potential-field inversion container: mesh, active mask, model, prediction, kind, history and diagnostics. Interpret units and flags by kind; the container does not certify convergence or recovery.
inversion.JointInversionResult: Joint container with both models/predictions, shared geometry and diagnostics. Inspect each dataset's misfit and inner/outer criteria.
inversion_workflows.save_manifest: Publish a serialisable numerical-workflow manifest at the given path using the module's saving logic. Provenance infrastructure does not itself calculate or validate physics.
line_processing.residual_statistics: Summarise crossover differences after line corrections, optionally restricted by keep. Statistics describe supplied crossovers, not absolute survey error.
magnetic_compensation.calibrate_tolles_l: Fit Tolles–Lawson calibration from magnetic, vector and time channels. Requires reference field and confirmation of low-gradient conditions; retains ridge and gap controls.
magnetic_compensation.apply_tolles_lawso: Apply an existing Tolles–Lawson model to compatible field/vector/time channels. Review time units, gaps and column correspondence before reuse.
magnetic_compensation.apply_vector_calib: Apply existing vector calibration to selected columns using stored model/component order. It neither refits coefficients nor corrects a geographic datum.
magnetic_pipeline.MagneticPipelineOption: Options for magnetic products and preparation. Fields describe the actual recipe, not automatically inferred acquisition settings.
Validate magnetic-pipeline settings before calculation. Syntactic validity still requires suitable physical units, directions and observations.
multisensor_fusion.stack_layers: Stack identically shaped 2D rasters and construct common finite support. Return values/mask; sufficient overlap is required and no registration or reprojection occurs.
multisensor_fusion.rgb_composite: Combine exactly three layers into dimensionless display RGB. Explicit bounds or common-support percentiles are returned; RGB does not retain physical units.
multisensor_fusion.pca_fusion: Clip percentiles, centre and standardise common-support variables, then decompose covariance. Record scales and deterministically signed loadings; components are not geological classes.
multisensor_fusion.anomaly_coincidence: Compute anomaly coincidence with a declared percentile threshold on compatible layers. Counts/products are not object probabilities or material classifications.
multisensor_project.vector_operations: Prepare vector operations using a file, target CRS, bounds and optional grid context. Check geopandas/PROJ transformation and support; horizontal reprojection does not transform heights.
oasis_style.oasis_observed_fft_size: Compatibility helper selecting an implemented FFT-size family. Historical comparisons cover a limited tested range; the name establishes no general engine equivalence.
oasis_style.prepare_independent: Prepare a grid with biharmonic treatment and explicit expansion under an unknown-count budget. Requires scikit-image; preparation is distinct from subsequent filtering.
oasis_style.central_valid: Compute a central difference along an explicit axis/spacing using finite neighbours. Unsupported boundaries remain missing rather than inventing one-sided derivatives.
operation_jobs.parse_job_parameters: Decode JSON and resolve explicit references to previously loaded arrays. Reject ambiguous/unsupported structures; no Python expression evaluation or scientific execution occurs.
paired_flights.PairOptions: Pairing assumptions and gates: height mode, separation range, point distance and output policy. Users supply acquisition values; no private site's settings are embedded.
paired_flights.PairResult: Paired-height output/support container. Inspect fields/masks for available coverage, accepted separation and pseudogradient instead of only the final array.
profile_distance.along_profile_distance: Cumulative horizontal distance in acquisition order, in metres. Geographic CRS uses geodesy; linear CRS converts units. Missing pairs are not bridged; separate lines before calling.
spectral.butterworth_lowpass: Build a radial low-pass gain from angular wavenumber, cutoff wavelength and order. It returns transfer, not a filtered grid; check units and apply through FFT.
spectral.butterworth_highpass: Build the complementary radial high-pass transfer. Cutoff uses Core wavelength conventions, not the Hz of a temporal series.
spectral.butterworth_bandpass: Combine long- and short-wavelength cutoffs into a radial Butterworth band. Check order and cutoff ordering; band choice changes interpreted scales.
spectral.ideal_bandpass: Build an abrupt radial pass band. Spectral discontinuity may cause spatial ringing; ideal does not mean artefact-free.
spectral.vertical_integration_transfer: Return 1/k for positive radial modes and zero at DC. Integration cannot recover a mean absent from those modes.
spherical_mvi.cartesian_from_spherical: Convert internal spherical parameters to Cartesian layout. This does not rotate CRSs or convert effective susceptibility to physical magnetisation.
spherical_mvi.spherical_from_cartesian: Convert Cartesian components to internal amplitude/angles. At zero amplitude or poles, interpret charts and degrees of freedom using module safeguards.
spherical_mvi.spherical_regularizer: Build amplitude/angle regularisation for supplied mesh, active mask, reference and norms. This low-level component must not be replaced with scalar regularisation ignoring mixed units.
spherical_mvi.run_spherical_mvi: Run staged spherical MVI with explicit initial Cartesian budget, maximum amplitude, angle norms and IRLS strategy. Read primary-engine options/diagnostics; stage completion does not establish true geological direction.
survey_correction_pipeline.MagneticCorre: Magnetic acquisition-correction recipe and auxiliary channels. Validate timing, units, grouping and base support before reuse on another dataset.
Check correction settings and reject invalid values/combinations. It does not certify base quality or estimate missing metadata.
survey_grid_pipeline.run_magnetic_grid_p: Coordinate database-channel processing and publication on a template grid. Geometry, correction and settings are explicit; retain support, versions and cancellation controls.
survey_processing.grid_survey: Tiled gridding kernel with coordinator-supplied core, halo, radius and callbacks. Options may distinguish directions; the call does not automatically select CRS, resolution or physics.
survey_recipes.prepare_channel_step: Prepare a formula/filter from a lineage node, checking database and current versions without substituting newer inputs. Return a review plan, not execution.
survey_store.Formula.__init__: Parse and validate the restricted channel arithmetic language. Identify dependencies and reject unsupported operations without Python eval.
survey_store.Formula.calculate: Evaluate the validated tree on named channel arrays. The caller owns row alignment/units; calculation does not sort or join rows.
survey_store.SurveyStore: SQLite-catalogue/Parquet-version store with selective reads. Keep catalogue and data coherent; public calls use database/channel identifiers, not arbitrary catalogue paths.
survey_store.SurveyStore.__init__: Open an existing workspace or create one with create true. Creation validates the destination and avoids treating an old data folder as a new database.
survey_store.SurveyStore.databases: List registered databases and catalogue metadata without loading all channel values.
survey_store.SurveyStore.channels: Read channels and current versions. Use version_id to freeze reviewed input; names alone do not identify immutable content.
survey_store.SurveyStore.history: Read database event history. It complements lineage and is not independent evidence of scientific correctness.
survey_store.SurveyStore.import_file: Import a new database in batches using reviewed text options where supplied. Preserve originals and publish complete data/catalogue; check counts and units afterwards.
survey_store.SurveyStore.derive: Calculate a formula as a derived version with unit/dependencies. expected_versions checks reviewed inputs; new_channel_only can require a new name.
survey_store.SurveyStore.rename_channel: Change channel name and optional unit label. Metadata relabelling does not numerically convert values; physical conversion must be an explicit transformation.
survey_store.SurveyStore.configure_geome: Associate X/Y channels and CRS definition with the catalogue, without reprojection or elevation transformation.
survey_store.SurveyStore.export_csv: Batch-export chosen columns to a new destination with optional row filters. Preserve recipe/CRS/units separately if the CSV consumer cannot retain them.
survey_text_import.ColumnSpec: Reviewed text-column definition: name, type and declared options. These fields are conversion recipe, not metadata inferred solely from a name.
survey_text_import.TextImportOptions: Survey-parser recipe: encoding, separators, rows, comments, missing values and columns. Inspection suggests fields from a sample; review the whole-file format.
survey_text_import.TextImportOptions.to_: Serialise parser settings and columns for review or recipe retention.
survey_text_import.TextImportOptions.val: Check parser consistency, row indices, modes and columns. A valid configuration may still encounter malformed later data.
survey_text_import.convert: Convert one token according to its column and null/decimal rules. Text types preserve identifiers that numeric conversion could damage.
survey_text_import.parsed_rows: Iterate converted survey rows under explicit settings, respecting structure, comments and cancellation without loading the full database.
survey_text_import.preview: Return a bounded converted-row preview. Its limit does not establish that the remainder has identical structure.
survey_text_import.arrow_batches: Convert rows to Arrow batches of the declared size, retaining parser types/nulls. Requires PyArrow.
terrain_tree_walk.get_builder: Lazily obtain the Numba-compiled terrain-tree constructor. Internal adaptive-method infrastructure, not a complete correction API by itself.
terrain_tree_walk.get_walker: Obtain the compiled terrain traversal. The module avoids disk compilation cache outside the caller's environment; physical tolerances belong to the invoking method.
text_import.inspect_text: Inspect a table through the historical pandas API with explicit separator, encoding, headers and missing-value options. This differs from the workspace survey parser.
text_import.csv_options: Translate a table inspection into reader settings. Review before reuse; do not mix with the survey parser's TextImportOptions.
text_import.read_text_table: Read a table through the historical reader with optional nrows. Requires tables; whole-table loading can exceed batch-channel memory use.
vector_grid_audit.polygon_samples: Extract raster support inside a valid polygon on a north-up lattice. Review window/mask/coverage; no reprojection from an assumed CRS occurs.
vector_grid_audit.prepared_samples: Sample precomputed polygon indices and report expected/valid cells and coverage. Indices require the same lattice; do not reuse after changing transform or shape.
